typed_decisions_runtime_probe.$comment: NOT a shipped SDK path. probes/scoring on the Galaxy S26: the LiteRT-LM Kotlin binding of the kotlin-text-scoring branch (Session.runTextScoring / saveCheckpoint / rewindToCheckpoint) with the pending fix of google-ai-edge/LiteRT-LM#3562 applied, built and synced in as the README of the probe says. One decision = one prefill of the rendered prompt, the three option letters scored, a rewind between them (shared arm); the direct arm prefills afresh for every letter. Medians over the rows, warm, one phone, one afternoon; the thermal status is recorded per run. The agreement columns compare the quantized bundle with the fp32 last-position logits of the same prompts (and, for MiniCPM5-2B, with the same bundle's own graph read on a Mac); they measure quantization, not the binding. No ranking between runtimes is implied.
